source: M5 drop-in T-nut for 2020 profile (common catalogue part, e.g. Misumi HNTT5-5 / generic drop-in): about 10.0 x 9.7 x 3.5 mm plate, M5x0.8 thread. The nut's long side (10 mm) turns across the 6.2 mm slot opening and sits behind the lips in the 11 mm slot interior; plate thickness 3.5 mm is a catalogue value that varies +/-0.3 mm between vendors. Clearance hole for M5 per ISO 273 medium: 5.5 mm.
frame: fastener: axis along Z, origin on the bearing face (the face that presses against the lips), body toward -Z (deeper in the slot), screw enters from +Z

plate_length.source: catalogue: nut length across the slot

plate_width.source: catalogue: nut width along the slot

plate_thickness.source: catalogue: nut thickness (assumed +/-0.3 mm between vendors)

slot_opening.source: 2020 profile slot opening (the nut must be wider than this)

slot_inner_width.source: 2020 profile slot interior width the nut must fit inside (assumed, extrusion_2020 notes)

clearance_diameter.source: ISO 273 medium clearance hole for M5

min_engagement.source: one thread diameter for a steel screw into a steel nut (engineering convention)

self_checks.name: nut wider than the slot opening
thread cut fits the plate width
